bibl.title: Counting the Past in Herodotus' Histories.
bibl.seg: Valeria Sergueenkova, Counting the Past in Herodotus' Histories.
bibl.note: 1. Visualizing multitudes: three ways of counting people. - 2. Visualizing power: metonymy and Herodotus' "yardstick" [the pyramid built by Mycerinus in 2.134-135 as the most explicit demonstration of his metonymical logic]. - 3. Visualizing deep time: pyramids and natural history [on the description of Cheops' pyramid in 2.124 and of the nature of Egypt in 2.5-2.15].
